question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Caustic
solution:
The correct answer is 'Acidic'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given word '**Caustic'** means a substance, especially a strong acid; capable of destroying or eating away by chemical action(एक पदार्थ, विशेष रूप से एक मजबूत एसिड; रासायनिक क्रिया द्वारा नष्ट करने या खाने में सक्षम)

 
 
• ***Example:** To know the significance of caustic soda, it is vital to understand the dyeing process.*
 
 
 
• The marked option **'Acidic' **means having the properties of an acid, or containing acid; having a pH below 7(अम्लीय)
 
• From the** given meaning and the example sentence above,** it is clear that 'acidic' and 'caustic' are synonyms.
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 1.**
